UpdateSourceArgs: -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; Set-Location -LiteralPath '{{$FullRootDir}}'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path 'server','upload' | Out-Null; $z = Get-ChildItem -Path 'upload' -Filter '*.zip' -File | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 1; if ($z) { Write-Output ('Extracting ' + $z.Name + ' into the server folder'); tar.exe -xf $z.FullName -C server; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Output ('Could not extract ' + $z.Name + '. Upload it again and click Update'); exit 1 }; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath 'server/Y51_SE2Online.DedicatedServer.exe')) { Write-Output ($z.Name + ' is not the SE2 Online dedicated server zip (no Y51_SE2Online.DedicatedServer.exe inside)'); exit 1 }; Remove-Item -LiteralPath $z.FullName -Force; Write-Output 'SE2 Online server installed. The uploaded zip was removed' } elseif (Test-Path -LiteralPath 'server/Y51_SE2Online.DedicatedServer.exe') { Write-Output 'No new server zip in the upload folder. Keeping the installed SE2 Online server' } else { Write-Output 'SE2 Online server files not found. Download the dedicated server zip from https://se2-online.yellow51.dev/ (sign in with Steam), upload it to the upload folder with the File Manager, then click Update again'; exit 1 }"

-c "cd \"{{$FullRootDir}}\" && mkdir -p server upload; z=$(ls -t upload/*.zip 2>/dev/null | head -n1); if [[ -n \"$z\" ]]; then echo \"Extracting $(basename \"$z\") into the server folder\"; if ! unzip -oq \"$z\" -d server; then echo \"Could not extract $(basename \"$z\"). Upload it again and click Update\"; exit 1; fi; if [[ ! -f server/Y51_SE2Online.DedicatedServer.exe ]]; then echo \"$(basename \"$z\") is not the SE2 Online dedicated server zip (no Y51_SE2Online.DedicatedServer.exe inside)\"; exit 1; fi; rm -f \"$z\"; echo \"SE2 Online server installed. The uploaded zip was removed\"; elif [[ -f server/Y51_SE2Online.DedicatedServer.exe ]]; then echo \"No new server zip in the upload folder. Keeping the installed SE2 Online server\"; else echo \"SE2 Online server files not found. Download the dedicated server zip from https://se2-online.yellow51.dev/ (sign in with Steam), upload it to the upload folder with the File Manager, then click Update again\"; exit 1; fi"

-NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12; Set-Location -LiteralPath '{{$FullBaseDir}}server'; try { $v = (Invoke-RestMethod -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'https://builds.dotnet.microsoft.com/dotnet/release-metadata/9.0/releases.json').'latest-runtime' } catch { Write-Output 'Could not reach the Microsoft .NET release feed'; exit 1 }; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath ('dotnet/shared/Microsoft.WindowsDesktop.App/' + $v)) { Write-Output ('.NET Desktop Runtime ' + $v + ' already installed. Skipping'); exit 0 }; Remove-Item -LiteralPath 'dotnet' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path 'dotnet' | Out-Null; try { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri ('https://builds.dotnet.microsoft.com/dotnet/Runtime/' + $v + '/dotnet-runtime-' + $v + '-win-x64.zip') -OutFile 'dotnet-runtime.zip' -ErrorAction Stop; Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri ('https://builds.dotnet.microsoft.com/dotnet/WindowsDesktop/' + $v + '/windowsdesktop-runtime-' + $v + '-win-x64.zip') -OutFile 'dotnet-desktop.zip' -ErrorAction Stop } catch { Write-Output 'Download failed from the Microsoft CDN. Aborting'; exit 1 }; tar.exe -xf dotnet-runtime.zip -C dotnet; tar.exe -xf dotnet-desktop.zip -C dotnet; Remove-Item -LiteralPath 'dotnet-runtime.zip','dotnet-desktop.zip' -Force; Write-Output ('.NET Desktop Runtime ' + $v + ' installed')"

-c "cd \"{{$FullBaseDir}}server\" || exit 1; v=$(wget -qO- https://builds.dotnet.microsoft.com/dotnet/release-metadata/9.0/releases.json | grep -o '\"latest-runtime\": *\"[0-9.]*\"' | head -n1 | grep -o '[0-9][0-9.]*'); if [[ -z \"$v\" ]]; then echo \"Could not reach the Microsoft .NET release feed\"; exit 1; fi; if [[ -d \"dotnet/shared/Microsoft.WindowsDesktop.App/$v\" ]]; then echo \".NET Desktop Runtime $v already installed. Skipping\"; exit 0; fi; rm -rf dotnet && mkdir -p dotnet; wget -qO dotnet-runtime.zip https://builds.dotnet.microsoft.com/dotnet/Runtime/$v/dotnet-runtime-$v-win-x64.zip && wget -qO dotnet-desktop.zip https://builds.dotnet.microsoft.com/dotnet/WindowsDesktop/$v/windowsdesktop-runtime-$v-win-x64.zip || { echo \"Download failed from the Microsoft CDN. Aborting\"; exit 1; }; unzip -oq dotnet-runtime.zip -d dotnet && unzip -oq dotnet-desktop.zip -d dotnet; rm -f dotnet-runtime.zip dotnet-desktop.zip; echo \".NET Desktop Runtime $v installed\""
